tool_rights.without_it: no governed file tools, and no decision on a native tool call

approvals.without_it: a permission request cannot be answered, so every one of them is a denial

egress.without_it: no route to any provider; nothing can run

record.without_it: runs still execute, but nothing about them is recorded or comparable

admission.without_it: the router sees no quota, calls every provider unknown, and holds the run
